subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should this experimental export command remain strict—refusing drifted or incomplete installed state—or should OpenClaw also support an explicit snapshot export mode with a machine-readable drift report?
rationale: The current PR and documentation select strict rejection, while review discussion proposes a broader snapshot workflow with materially different portability, lineage, and support expectations; that public contract cannot be chosen safely by patch review alone.

options.title: Keep strict exact-state export
options.body: Approve export only for complete, corroborated installed state and defer any drifted snapshot capability to a separately designed follow-up.

options.title: Add explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Permit drifted or partial export only behind a distinct mode that emits a machine-readable drift and lineage report.

options.title: Pause export scope
options.body: Hold this slice until the Claws RFC or an owner decision defines the intended portability and recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Keep strict exact-state export
recommendation.body: Approve export only for complete, corroborated installed state and defer any drifted snapshot capability to a separately designed follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comments and follow-up product framing identify the central reproducibility and lineage decision for this export surface.
